description: Java class DomPullParser that wraps an XML DOM to provide a pull parser interface, extending LayoutPullParser. It manages a stack of DOM Elements to parse XML documents and provides methods for attribute access, navigation, and creating empty documents.

classes.name: DomPullParser
classes.description: A pull parser implementation that wraps an XML DOM, allowing XML documents to be parsed with a stack-based approach, providing attribute and node navigation, and creating new documents.

methods.name: DomPullParser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the parser with a root DOM Element.

methods.name: setViewCookies
methods.description: Sets view cookies to be returned during parsing.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root DOM Element.

methods.name: getCurrentElement
methods.description: Returns the current DOM Element on top of the node stack.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute by index from the current element.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a DOM Element onto the node stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top DOM Element from the node stack.

methods.name: getViewCookie
methods.description: Returns the view cookie associated with the current element.

methods.name: getViewKey
methods.description: Legacy method returning the view cookie.

methods.name: getParser
methods.description: Returns null; placeholder for obtaining a nested parser.

methods.name: getPositionDescription
methods.description: Provides a string describing the current position in the XML document.

methods.name: getAttributeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of attributes in the current element.

methods.name: getAttributeName
methods.description: Returns the name of an attribute by index.

methods.name: getAttributeNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace URI of an attribute by index.

methods.name: getAttributePrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix of an attribute by index.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the value of an attribute by index.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the value of an attribute given its namespace and local name.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the current depth in the XML document.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current element's tag name.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace URI of the current element.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix of the current element.

methods.name: isEmptyElementTag
methods.description: Checks if the current element is an empty element.

methods.name: onNextFromStartDocument
methods.description: Initializes parsing from the root element.

methods.name: onNextFromStartTag
methods.description: Advances to the first child or end of the current element.

methods.name: onNextFromEndTag
methods.description: Moves to the next sibling or back to parent when an end tag is encountered.

methods.name: createEmptyPlainDocument
methods.description: Creates a new, empty, namespace-aware XML Document.
